speaker: Doctor
text: Since your basic labs are normal, let's focus on the neurological system. Does your ataxia worsen significantly when you try to stand up and walk in a straight line, and have you noticed any weakness or numbness in your legs?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details; the "drunk" appearance and right-sided clumsiness suggest a focal neurological issue rather than a generalized metabolic one. Have you noticed any changes in your vision, such as double vision or a loss of color perception, and do you experience any issues with your sense of balance when your eyes are closed?
